opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motions of respondents John H. Pir-tle, Robert Everett Johnson, Anthony Sneed, and Michael Craig Slater for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certio-rari as to John H. Pirtle, Robert Everett Johnson, Anthony Sneed, and Michael Craig Slater granted, judgments vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of Swarthout v. Cooke, 562 U. S. 216 (2011) (per curiam). Certiorari as to Ron Mosley denied.
